import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, algo
prof = json.load(open('/tmp/bigprof2.json'))
fab = json.load(open('/tmp/bigfab2.json'))
plan = algo.compile_plan(prof, fab)
with open('/tmp/bigreq.jsonl','w') as f:
    f.write(json.dumps({'op':'plan','profile':prof,'fabric':fab},separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
    f.write(json.dumps({'op':'audit','profile':prof,'fabric':fab,'proposal':plan},separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
print('written')
EOF
timeout 900 python3 -B /tmp/mkbig.py && ls -la /tmp/bigreq.jsonl && cat > /tmp/runbig.sh <<'EOF'
time timeout 600 python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py < /tmp/bigreq.jsonl > /tmp/bigout.jsonl
EOF
bash /tmp/runbig.sh && wc -c /tmp/bigout.jsonl && head -c 300 /tmp/bigout.jsonl
